briefing: Markets were risk-on today with NASDAQ +1.4% and S&P 500 +0.9%. With cash above the $500 threshold and 3 open slots, we deployed into NVDA, NOK, and SVM — all showing full bullish signal confirmation — while diversifying away from the portfolio's existing semiconductor/AI concentration.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Diversification means spreading investments across different sectors so a downturn in one area doesn't sink the whole portfolio. Today, instead of adding more tech/semiconductor names on top of existing holdings, new buys were chosen from telecom and materials sectors to reduce correlated risk.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 分散投資是指將資金分佈於不同行業，避免單一板塊下跌拖累整個組合。今日在原有半導體及科技持倉基礎上，新買入標的特意選擇電訊及原材料板塊，以降低持倉之間的相關風險。

market_education.summary_en: Broad market strength today pushed both the NASDAQ (+1.4%) and S&P 500 (+0.9%) higher, with technology and momentum names leading gains as risk appetite improved. Breadth was strong, with numerous stocks showing bullish MACD crossovers and volume surges consistent with institutional buying. This risk-on tone supported deploying idle cash into high-conviction, multi-signal-confirmed candidates.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市走強，納斯達克指數升1.4%，標普500指數升0.9%，科技股及動能股領漲，市場風險胃納明顯回升。市場廣度良好，不少個股出現MACD黃金交叉及成交量放大，反映機構資金流入迹象。在這種風險偏好升溫的氣氛下，組合利用閒置現金買入訊號齊備、信心度較高的標的。

trades.reasoning: All momentum signals confirmed (MACD crossover, rising histogram, price above SMA-20, volume surge) with RSI 61.4 still below overbought, and NVDA offers the best liquidity/quality among top-scored candidates.
Full signal confirmation at a reasonable valuation, and telecom exposure diversifies the portfolio away from its current semiconductor/AI concentration (MU, INOD, QQQ, OLED).
Full signal confirmation in the materials/mining sector, providing diversification uncorrelated to the tech-heavy existing book while deploying idle cash on a risk-on day.
